# Project Overview

Study Site: Research was split between two different zones within the greater Yasuni Biosphere Reserve. Tiputini Biodiversity Station (TBS) served as the faunally intact site, whereas Yasuni Research Station (YRS) served as the defaunated site. Both sites are situated along the Tiputini River within the province of Orellana, Ecuador. TBS, approximately 45 km east of YRS, is only accessible by boat. YRS is along the Maxus Oil Road, and is less integrated into the Amazonian ecosystem. Additionally, unsustainable hunting activities by the indigenous communities have been prominent in the surrounding region at YRS for multiple decades, as noted from 2014. This is thought to be the root cause of defaunation in this zone. 

	I transferred between the two research stations every two weeks, starting my first rotation at TBS on June 10. Time at each station was spent working on 3 separate projects: my herpetofauna surveys, frugivory surveys, and an overarching seed enemy and dispersal project. 

	The rainy season in Northeastern Ecuador is at its peak between March and July. I conducted my study between the months of June and August, 2024. The average high temperature for June in this region is 85.66° F, with the average low of 70.05° F. July has an average high temperature of 86.29° F and an average low of 69.13° F. August has an average high temperature of 91.35° F and an average low of 69.60° F. June receives 143mm of precipitation on average each year, whereas July receives 99.69mm and August receives 77.55mm. (https://weatherandclimate.com/ecuador/orellana/boca-tiputini) 
Put project description here (field sites, time frame of collection,sampling scheme, type of data (eg. species ID,temp, etc.) )

Surveys: Herpetofauna were sampled using visual surveys on foot by two surveyors/night. Trail systems at each site served as the sampling paths. The surveys were repeated around 6 times on each rotation while in the field, and resampled on the second rotations. The surveys typically began around 20:00-20:30 and lasted until 23:00-00:00 CST. At each site, habitat matches were compared and assessed and trails through that habitat were consistently walked. Two different types of habitat, Terra Firma (uplands) and Varzea (flooded forest) were surveyed on the herp nocturnal walks. In addition to this, two significant bodies of water were also surveyed at each site, primarily consisting of oxbow lakes with one year-round large pond. 

	Surveyors used FENIX HM60R headlamps while conducting night surveys. They carefully examined all surrounding habitat, including understory trees, shrubs, vines, water bodies, forest floor, and middle-canopy. Amphibians of the order Anura gave off reflective eyeshine and were easier to sample for, whereas members of Squamata did not. More information about this will be within the discussion section. Effort hours will be calculated based on survey time length and number of surveyors. 

	Additionally, environmental information was taken throughout the course of each survey. Temperature and humidity data was collected with a Mengshen meter in 30 minute intervals on surveys. Understory vegetation density was also measured every 15 minutes along each trail. A 1.5m PVC pipe was randomly placed upright just off the right side of the trail at each measuring point, and the number of leaves making contact with the pipe was counted. 

	Weather and wind were noted before each survey in four nominal categories, with weather either being “clear, partly cloudy, cloudy, rainy” and wind being “no wind, felt on face, branches move, trees move”. I also accounted for precipitation that had already occurred in 6-hour blocks as “time window of last rain event”. 

	Once an animal was found, the first step of the protocol was to note what time of night the find occurred. After this, the temperature and humidity was once again collected. A rangefinder was used to estimate the perpendicular distance of each animal from the trail. A GPS was used to mark and log the coordinates of each animal found. Animals were given a two-letter code based on the Order and Suborder followed by a number, indicating its position of being found. For example, the code of the 9th snake found of the season would be SK09. Species found were also identified to the lowest taxonomic level in the field, and photographs of individuals were taken both to get positive IDs later in the lab when not possible in the field, but also to avoid counting re-captures.

	Snakes found during non-survey times were also recorded. These individuals were split into one of two categories of detection. The first is an “Opportunistic Encounter” (OE), which is any snake that was found by me while out working on other non-herpetofauna projects in the field. The other type of detection is the Third Party Encounter (TPE). This was any snake that was found by other research groups during my rotations at each station, identified to lowest possible taxonomy. The same data was taken for these individuals. GPS coordinates, time of detection, trail, observer, estimation of distance from trail, and habitat type. Because the third-party observers often didn’t have access to the climate data logger, this information was retrieved later on from each station’s respective weather tower data, based on the time of detection. 

Snakes were given a classification as to whether they were small mammal consumers or not. Information on this was retrieved from literature such as online publications, the book Reptiles and Amphibians of the Amazon by R.D. and Patricia Bartlett, and the expert field book Reptiles of Ecuador. 

# Read in and prep data

## Read in

This data was cleaned some in initial steps in 2024-2026 (see archived code). Note that temp and humidity data was removed for 4 surveys at YRS that took place after July 11, 2025, during which the team lost confidence in the data collection instrument. 

```{r data read in}
all_surv_records <- read.csv("Data/all_survey_records_aug2026.csv")
# a record of every segment surveyed, afternoon and night, with length and time

amph_lz <- read.csv("Data/amph_lz_cleaned_aug2026.csv")
# cleaned amphibian and lizard data - a record of every individual found, when, and what segment
# make sure there are no duplicates...
amph_lz <- amph_lz %>%
  distinct(Animal_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) # evidently there was 1

# I cleaned frogs and added a tadpole phase column, now they are a sep df
frogs_df <- read.csv("frogs.csv")
frogs_df$Start_Date <- mdy(frogs_df$Start_Date)
# remove the morning survey
frogs_df <- frogs_df %>% filter(Survey_Type != "Morning")

env_2025 <- read.csv("Data/env_2025_cleaned.csv", encoding = "latin1")
# 2025 env data

env_24_25_nights <- read.csv("Data/env_24_25_nights_aug2026.csv")
# night time survey environmental data both years

small.mamms.df <- read.csv("Data/small_mammals_aug2026.csv")
# records of small mammals spotted during surveys

snakes.master <- read.csv("Data/snakes_master_cleaned_aug2026.csv")
# all snake records

snakes.sur <- read.csv("Data/snake_surveys_cleaned_aug2026.csv")
# all the snake survey records, cleaned
# this version of snakes.sur has those two duplicates (SK04, 05) removed

```


# Sampling Effort Summaries

```{r mean efforts}

# mean and sd search effort per station per survey type
all_surv_records %>%
  group_by(Station, Survey_Type) %>%
  summarize(mean_search_time_hrs = mean(Effort_hrs),
            sd = sd(Effort_hrs))

# mean and sd meters searched per station per survey type
temp <-all_surv_records %>%
  group_by(Station, Start_Date, Survey_Type) %>%
  summarize(total_meters_surveyed = sum(Seg_dist_m))

temp %>%
  group_by(Station, Survey_Type) %>%
  summarize(mean_length = mean(total_meters_surveyed),
            sd_length = sd(total_meters_surveyed))

rm(temp)

all_surv_records %>%
  group_by(Station, Survey_Type) %>%
  summarize(cumulative_m = sum(Seg_dist_m),
            cumulative_surveys = n_distinct(Start_Date_Start_Time))

```

# Small Mammals

## small mammal model 

```{r small mammal model}

smam.mod1 <- glmmTMB(smamm.500m ~ Station + (1|Parent_Trail_LongName), data = small.mamms.df, family = tweedie(link = "log"))

sim <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = smam.mod1, plot = T)

summary(smam.mod1) # great, can report this

testDispersion(smam.mod1, plot = F)
testZeroInflation(smam.mod1, plot = F)

Anova(smam.mod1)
rm(sim, smam.mod1)
```

## small mammal summary data

```{r small mammal summs}

# make summary of mean and SE and keep for plotting later
small.mamms.summ <- small.mamms.df %>%
  group_by(Station) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(smamm.500m),
            sd = sd(smamm.500m),
            n = n()) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n))

# also look at raw mammal counts
sum(small.mamms.df$Number_of_Small_Mammals_Spotted[small.mamms.df$Station == "YRS"])

sum(small.mamms.df$Number_of_Small_Mammals_Spotted[small.mamms.df$Station == "TBS"])

# report mean and sd of n encountered per survey at each station:

env_24_25_nights %>%
  group_by(Station) %>%
  summarise(mean_detections_per_survey = mean(Number_of_Small_Mammals_Spotted),
            standard_deviation = sd(Number_of_Small_Mammals_Spotted))

# make data object
small.mamms.df$Start_Date<- ymd(small.mamms.df$Start_Date)

# look per year
small.mamms.df$Year<- factor(format(small.mamms.df$Start_Date, "%Y"))

# summarize per year
small.mamms.summ.yr <- small.mamms.df %>%
  group_by(Station, Year) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(smamm.500m),
            sd = sd(smamm.500m),
            n = n()) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n))

```

## small mammal plot

```{r small mammal plot}
# specify the dodge width for points
spec_dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.5)

small.mammal.plot <- ggplot(small.mamms.summ, aes(x = Station, y = mean)) +
  geom_point(data = small.mamms.df, aes(x = Station, y = smamm.500m), alpha = 0.3, position = position_jitterdodge()) + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se, width = 0.1)) +
  geom_point(position = spec_dodge, size = 2, shape = 22, fill = "grey") + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Unhunted", "Hunted")) + labs(x = NULL) +
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12)) + ylab("Individuals per 500m") + labs(title = "Small mammals") 

small.mammal.plot

# per year
small.mammal.plot.yearly <- ggplot(small.mamms.summ.yr, aes(x = Station, y = mean, shape = Year)) +
  geom_point(data = small.mamms.df, aes(x = Station, y = smamm.500m, shape = Year), alpha = 0.3, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1)) + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se, width = 0.1), position = spec_dodge) +
  geom_point(position = spec_dodge, size =2) + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Unhunted", "Hunted")) + labs(x = NULL) +
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12)) + ylab("Individuals per 500m") + labs(title = "Small mammals") 

small.mammal.plot.yearly
# this should be (a) in main text figure 

```

# Prep frog and lizard data

## Frogs

```{r frogs}

# survey distance data
survey_distance <- all_surv_records %>%
group_by(Station, Start_Date, Survey_Type) %>%
reframe(survey_length_m = sum(Seg_dist_m)) %>%
  distinct()

survey_distance$Start_Date<- ymd(survey_distance$Start_Date)

surveys_without_frogs <- survey_distance %>%
  filter(Start_Date %in% (setdiff(survey_distance$Start_Date, frogs_df$Start_Date))) %>%
  mutate(n = 0)

# add survey lengths to frog df
frogs_df<- left_join(frogs_df, survey_distance, by = c("Station", "Start_Date", "Survey_Type"))

# tallies
frogs_tallied <- frogs_df %>%
  group_by(Station, Start_Date, Survey_Type, survey_length_m) %>% tally()

# add instances without frogs found
frogs_tallied <- rbind(frogs_tallied, surveys_without_frogs)

rm(surveys_without_frogs)

frogs_tallied$n_500m <-(frogs_tallied$n/frogs_tallied$survey_length_m)*500
```

### Frog summary

```{r frog summary data}

# get summary data overall (regardless of year)
frog.summ <- frogs_tallied %>%
  group_by(Station) %>%
  reframe(mean = mean(n_500m),
           sd = sd(n_500m),
           sample_size = n()) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(sample_size))

# create year column
frogs_tallied$Year <- factor(format(frogs_tallied$Start_Date, "%Y"))

# get summary data per year
frog.summ.yr <- frogs_tallied %>%
  group_by(Station, Year) %>%
reframe(mean = mean(n_500m),
           sd = sd(n_500m),
           sample_size = n()) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(sample_size))

```

## Lizards

```{r lizards}
liz_df <- amph_lz %>%
  filter(Survey_Type != "Morning") %>%
  filter(Gross_ID == "Lizard")

liz_df$Start_Date <- ymd(liz_df$Date)

surveys_without_liz <- survey_distance %>%
  filter(Start_Date %in% (setdiff(survey_distance$Start_Date, liz_df$Start_Date))) %>%
  mutate(n = 0)

# add survey lengths to frog df
liz_df <- liz_df %>%
  select(Start_Date, Station, Survey_Type, Animal_ID)

liz_df<- left_join(liz_df, survey_distance, by = c("Station", "Start_Date", "Survey_Type"))

# tallies
liz_tallied <- liz_df %>%
  group_by(Station, Start_Date, Survey_Type, survey_length_m) %>% tally()

# add instances without frogs found
liz_tallied <- rbind(liz_tallied, surveys_without_liz)

rm(surveys_without_liz)

# get n per 500m
liz_tallied$n_500m <-(liz_tallied$n/liz_tallied$survey_length_m)*500
```

# Snakes

## Snakes pooled

```{r prep tot snake data}

# make one data frame of only the snake records (remove NAs where no snakes were found) 
surveys_with_snakes <- snakes.sur %>% filter(!is.na(Snake_ID)) %>% # if snake ID is na, there were no snakes found that survey
  select(Start_Date, Station)

# dates
surveys_with_snakes$Start_Date <- mdy(surveys_with_snakes$Start_Date)

# likewise, make one df of only cases where no snakes were found and keep relevant columns with it
surveys_without_snakes <- survey_distance %>%
  filter(Survey_Type == "Night" & !Start_Date %in% surveys_with_snakes$Start_Date) %>%
select(-Survey_Type)

# add n
surveys_without_snakes$n_snakes <-0

# add survey length data to surveys with snakes
# isolate distance info for nighttime surveys
survey_distance_nights <- survey_distance %>%
  filter(Survey_Type == "Night") %>%
  select(-Survey_Type) %>%
  distinct()
# now add
surveys_with_snakes <- left_join(surveys_with_snakes, survey_distance_nights)

# add a n snakes column to surveys with snakes
surveys_with_snakes$n_snakes <-1

surveys_with_snakes <- left_join(surveys_with_snakes, survey_distance_nights)

# rbind to add the surveys without snakes
all_surveys_data <- rbind(surveys_without_snakes, surveys_with_snakes)

# tally
all_snakes_tallied <- all_surveys_data %>%
  group_by(Station, Start_Date, survey_length_m) %>%
  reframe(n_snakes = sum(n_snakes))
# detection rate

all_snakes_tallied$n_500m <- 500*(all_snakes_tallied$n_snakes/all_snakes_tallied$survey_length_m)

# clean
rm(all_surveys_data, surveys_with_snakes, surveys_without_snakes)
```

## Surveys by two diet types

```{r prep diet df with survey level aggregation}

# same as above - see those annotations
surveys_with_snakes <- snakes.sur %>% filter(!is.na(Snake_ID)) %>% 
  select(Start_Date, Station, Snake_ID, Diet_Type)

surveys_with_snakes$Start_Date <- mdy(surveys_with_snakes$Start_Date)

survey_distance_nights <- survey_distance %>%
  filter(Survey_Type == "Night") %>%
  select(-Survey_Type) %>%
  distinct()

surveys_with_snakes <- left_join(surveys_with_snakes, survey_distance_nights)

surveys_with_snakes <- surveys_with_snakes %>%
  group_by(Station, Start_Date, survey_length_m, Diet_Type) %>%
  reframe(n_snakes = n())

surveys_with_snakes_wide <- surveys_with_snakes %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Diet_Type,
              values_from = n_snakes,
              values_fill = 0)

surveys_with_snakes <- surveys_with_snakes_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(no_mammals, consumes_mammals),
               names_to = "Diet_Type",
               values_to = "n_snakes")

surveys_without_snakes <- survey_distance %>%
  filter(Survey_Type == "Night" & !Start_Date %in% surveys_with_snakes$Start_Date) %>%
select(-Survey_Type)

# add n
surveys_without_snakes$n_snakes <-0

# add diet type
surveys_without_snakes_nomamms <- surveys_without_snakes
surveys_without_snakes_nomamms$Diet_Type <-"no_mammals"

surveys_without_snakes_mamms <- surveys_without_snakes
surveys_without_snakes_mamms$Diet_Type<- "consumes_mammals"

surveys_without_snakes_compelete <- rbind(surveys_without_snakes_mamms, surveys_without_snakes_nomamms)

two_guilds_tallied <- rbind(surveys_without_snakes_compelete, surveys_with_snakes)

two_guilds_tallied$n_500m <- 500*(two_guilds_tallied$n_snakes/two_guilds_tallied$survey_length_m)

two_guilds_tallied$Year <- factor(format(two_guilds_tallied$Start_Date, "%Y"))

# remove one outlier
two_guilds_tallied <- two_guilds_tallied[-44,]

rm(surveys_with_snakes, surveys_with_snakes_wide, surveys_without_snakes, surveys_without_snakes_compelete, surveys_without_snakes_mamms, surveys_without_snakes_nomamms)
```

## Segments by two diet types

```{r prep diet df with segment level aggregation}
segments_with_snakes <- snakes.sur %>% filter(!is.na(Snake_ID)) %>% 
  select(Start_Date, Station, Segment, Snake_ID, Diet_Type, Seg_dist_m)

segments_with_snakes$Start_Date <- mdy(segments_with_snakes$Start_Date)

segment_sampling_efforts <- all_surv_records %>%
  filter(Survey_Type == "Night") %>%
  select(Start_Date, Station, Segment, Seg_dist_m) %>%
  distinct()

segment_distances <- all_surv_records %>%
  filter(Survey_Type == "Night") %>%
  select(Station, Segment, Seg_dist_m) %>%
  distinct()

segments_with_snakes <- left_join(segments_with_snakes, segment_distances)

segments_with_snakes <- segments_with_snakes %>%
  group_by(Station, Start_Date, Segment, Seg_dist_m, Diet_Type) %>%
  reframe(n_snakes = n())

segments_with_snakes_wide <- segments_with_snakes %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Diet_Type,
              values_from = n_snakes,
              values_fill = 0)

segments_with_snakes <- segments_with_snakes_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(no_mammals, consumes_mammals),
               names_to = "Diet_Type",
               values_to = "n_snakes")

segment_sampling_efforts$Start_Date <-ymd( segment_sampling_efforts$Start_Date)

segments_without_snakes <- segment_sampling_efforts %>%
  anti_join(segments_with_snakes, by = c("Segment", "Start_Date"))

segments_without_snakes$n_snakes <-0

segments_without_snakes_nomamms <- segments_without_snakes
segments_without_snakes_nomamms$Diet_Type <-"no_mammals"

segments_without_snakes_mamms <- segments_without_snakes
segments_without_snakes_mamms$Diet_Type<- "consumes_mammals"

segments_without_snakes_complete <- rbind(segments_without_snakes_mamms, segments_without_snakes_nomamms)

two_guilds_tallied_per_segment <- rbind(segments_without_snakes_complete, segments_with_snakes)

two_guilds_tallied_per_segment$Year <- factor(format(two_guilds_tallied_per_segment$Start_Date, "%Y"))

two_guilds_tallied_per_segment$n_500m <- (two_guilds_tallied_per_segment$n_snakes/two_guilds_tallied_per_segment$Seg_dist_m)*500

rm(segments_with_snakes, segments_with_snakes_wide, segments_without_snakes, segments_without_snakes_compelete, segments_without_snakes_mamms, segments_without_snakes_nomamms)
```

# Env data

Format the humidity and understory and the temp data and then get means and add them to the herp dfs

```{r prep env and join to obs dfs}

humidity_long <- env_2025 %>%
  select(Date, Station, Survey_Type, 
         Humidity_1:Humidity_8, Humidity_Final) %>%
  pivot_longer(names_to = "Measurement",
               cols = Humidity_1:Humidity_Final,
               values_to = "Humidity", names_repair = "unique")
# remove NAs
humidity_long <- humidity_long %>%
  na.omit()

# fix date
humidity_long$Start_Date <- mdy(humidity_long$Date)

humidity_long <- humidity_long %>%
  select(-Date)
# there are 3 humidity readings that are very low (<70) and are all the 1 (or 2nd) reading of the night - this could be error, and our sampling intensity is robust enough for us to not worry about influencing results by removing these outliers. 

#humidity_long <- humidity_long %>%
 # filter(Humidity > 70)

# repeat with temp
temp_long <- env_2025 %>%
  select(Date, Station, Survey_Type, 
         Temperature_1:Temperature_8, Temperature_Final) %>%
  pivot_longer(names_to = "Measurement",
               cols = Temperature_1:Temperature_Final,
               values_to = "Temperature", names_repair = "unique")

# remove NAs
temp_long <- temp_long %>%
  na.omit()

# date
temp_long$Start_Date <- mdy(temp_long$Date)
temp_long <- temp_long %>%
  select(-Date)

# understory
understory_long <- env_2025 %>%
  select(Date, Station, Survey_Type, 
         Understory_Density_1:Understory_Density_13, Understory_Density_Final) %>%
  pivot_longer(names_to = "Measurement",
               cols = Understory_Density_1:Understory_Density_Final,
               values_to = "Understory", names_repair = "unique")
# remove NAs
understory_long <- understory_long %>%
  na.omit()

# fix date
understory_long$Start_Date <- mdy(understory_long$Date)
understory_long <- understory_long %>%
  select(-Date)

# 2024 data

# pull out 2024 year only
env_24_25_nights$Start_Date <- ymd(env_24_25_nights$Start_Date)
env_24_25_nights$Year<- factor(format(env_24_25_nights$Start_Date, "%Y"))
  
env_2024 <- env_24_25_nights %>%
  filter(Year == "2024")

# humidity - 2024 - pivot

# simplify
env_2024 <- env_2024 %>%
  select(-Effort_hrs, -Notes, -Number_of_Small_Mammals_Spotted, -Number_of_Water_Bodies_Spotted, -Surveyors, -Searching_Time, -Meters, -Order, -Survey_Start_Time, -Survey_End_Time)

humidity_long_2024 <- env_2024 %>%
  select(Start_Date, Station,
         Humidity_1:Humidity_8, Humidity_Final) %>%
  pivot_longer(names_to = "Measurement",
               cols = Humidity_1:Humidity_Final,
               values_to = "Humidity", names_repair = "unique")
# remove NAs

humidity_long_2024 <- humidity_long_2024 %>%
  na.omit()

# repeat with temp
temperature_long_2024 <- env_2024 %>%
  select(Start_Date, Station,
         Temperature_1:Temperature_8, Temperature_Final) %>%
  pivot_longer(names_to = "Measurement",
               cols = Temperature_1:Temperature_Final,
               values_to = "Temperature", names_repair = "unique")
# remove NAs

temperature_long_2024 <- temperature_long_2024 %>%
  na.omit()

# repeat with understory
understory_long_2024 <- env_2024 %>%
  select(Start_Date, Station,
         Understory_Density_1:Understory_Density_13, Understory_Density_Final) %>%
  pivot_longer(names_to = "Measurement",
               cols = Understory_Density_1:Understory_Density_Final,
               values_to = "Understory", names_repair = "unique")
# remove NAs

understory_long_2024 <- understory_long_2024 %>%
  na.omit()

# join
# add survey type column to 2024 env data
humidity_long_2024$Survey_Type <-"Night"
temperature_long_2024$Survey_Type <-"Night"
understory_long_2024$Survey_Type <-"Night"

humidity_all <- rbind(humidity_long, humidity_long_2024)
temperature_all <- rbind(temp_long, temperature_long_2024)
understory_all <-rbind(understory_long, understory_long_2024)

# get means
humidity_means <- humidity_all %>%
  filter(Humidity > 73) %>% # two afternoon survey outliers
  group_by(Station, Start_Date, Survey_Type) %>%
  reframe(mean_relative_humidity = mean(Humidity))

temperature_means <- temperature_all %>%
  group_by(Station, Start_Date, Survey_Type) %>%
  reframe(mean_temp_F = mean(Temperature))

understory_means <- understory_all %>%
  group_by(Station, Start_Date, Survey_Type) %>%
  reframe(mean_understory_leaves = mean(Understory))

# repeat with only the night time surveys for the snake data

humidity_means_night <- humidity_all %>%
  filter(Survey_Type == "Night") %>%
  group_by(Station, Start_Date) %>%
  reframe(mean_humidity = mean(Humidity))

temperature_means_night <- temperature_all %>%
  filter(Survey_Type == "Night") %>%
  group_by(Station, Start_Date) %>%
  reframe(mean_temp_F = mean(Temperature))


# center and scale
humidity_means$humidity_scaled <-scale(humidity_means$mean_relative_humidity)

temperature_means$temp_scaled <-scale(temperature_means$mean_temp_F)

# and for snake survey data only
humidity_means_night$humidity_scaled <-scale(humidity_means_night$mean_humidity)

temperature_means_night$temp_scaled <-scale(temperature_means_night$mean_temp_F)

# understory not included in models so not bothering to center and scale here
```

## Add Env to dfs
```{r add env to dfs}

frogs_tallied <- left_join(frogs_tallied, humidity_means)
frogs_tallied <- left_join(frogs_tallied, temperature_means)

liz_tallied <- left_join(liz_tallied, humidity_means)
liz_tallied <- left_join(liz_tallied, temperature_means)

all_snakes_tallied <-left_join(all_snakes_tallied, humidity_means_night)
all_snakes_tallied <- left_join(all_snakes_tallied, temperature_means_night)

two_guilds_tallied <- left_join(two_guilds_tallied, humidity_means_night)
two_guilds_tallied <- left_join(two_guilds_tallied, temperature_means_night)

two_guilds_tallied_per_segment <- left_join(two_guilds_tallied_per_segment, humidity_means_night)
two_guilds_tallied_per_segment <- left_join(two_guilds_tallied_per_segment, temperature_means_night)
```

```{r summarize hum and temp and und}

humidity_all$Year <- factor(format(humidity_all$Start_Date, "%Y"))

temperature_all$Year <- factor(format(temperature_all$Start_Date, "%Y"))

understory_all$Year <- factor(format(understory_all$Start_Date, "%Y"))


humidity_all <- humidity_all %>%
  filter(Survey_Type != "Morning")

humidity_summary_yr_survey_type <- humidity_all %>%
  filter(!(Year==2024 & Survey_Type == "Afternoon")) %>%
  filter(!(Survey_Type == "Morning")) %>%
  group_by(Station, Survey_Type, Year) %>%
  reframe(mean_humidity = mean(Humidity),
            sd = sd(Humidity),
            n = n()) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n))

# temperature
temperature_all <- temperature_all %>%
  filter(Survey_Type != "Morning")

temperature_summary_yr_survey_type <- temperature_all %>%
  filter(!(Year==2024 & Survey_Type == "Afternoon")) %>%
  filter(!(Survey_Type == "Morning")) %>%
  group_by(Station, Survey_Type, Year) %>%
  reframe(mean_temperature = mean(Temperature),
            sd = sd(Temperature),
            n = n()) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n))

# clean
rm(temperature_all, temp_long, humidity_all, humidity_long, humidity_long_2024, temperature_long_2024)

# understory
understory_all <- understory_all %>%
  filter(Survey_Type != "Morning")

understory_summary_yr_survey_type <- understory_all %>%
  filter(!(Year==2024 & Survey_Type == "Afternoon")) %>%
  filter(!(Survey_Type == "Morning")) %>%
  group_by(Station, Survey_Type, Year) %>%
  reframe(mean_understory = mean(Understory),
            sd = sd(Understory),
            n = n()) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n))

understory_summary <- understory_all %>%
  group_by(Station) %>%
  reframe(mean_understory = mean(Understory),
            sd = sd(Understory),
            n = n()) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n))

# clean
rm(understory_all, understory_summary_yr_survey_type, understory_summary)
```

# Frogs

## Frog models

```{r frog det rate model comparison, warning = FALSE}

# remove instances where some env vars are NA
frogs_tallied <- frogs_tallied %>%
  na.omit()

# null
frog.null <- glmmTMB(n_500m ~ 1, data = frogs_tallied, family = tweedie())

summary(frog.null)
# AIC 245.9

# survey type
frog.survtype <- glmmTMB(n_500m ~ Survey_Type, data = frogs_tallied, family = tweedie())

summary(frog.survtype)
# AIC 243.1 better

# hunting
frog.survtype.hunt <- glmmTMB(n_500m ~ Station + Survey_Type, data = frogs_tallied, family = tweedie())
summary(frog.survtype.hunt)
# 244.9 worse

# year
frog.survtype.year <- glmmTMB(n_500m ~ Survey_Type + Year, data = frogs_tallied, family = tweedie())
summary(frog.survtype.year)

# 245.0 worse

# humidity
frog.survtype.humidity <- glmmTMB(n_500m ~ Survey_Type + humidity_scaled, data = frogs_tallied, family = tweedie())
summary(frog.survtype.humidity)
# AIC 241.6 significantly better fit

# temperature

frog.survtype.humidity.temperature <- glmmTMB(n_500m ~ Survey_Type + humidity_scaled + temp_scaled, data = frogs_tallied, family = tweedie())
summary(frog.survtype.humidity.temperature)
# AIC 238.8 significantly better fit

frog_mod_names <- c("frog.null", "frog.survtype", "frog.survtype.hunt", "frog.survtype.year", "frog.survtype.humidity", "frog.survtype.humidity.temperature")

# compare
aictab(cand.set = list(frog.null, frog.survtype, frog.survtype.hunt, frog.survtype.year, frog.survtype.humidity, frog.survtype.humidity.temperature), modnames = frog_mod_names)

# best fit model results:
Anova(frog.survtype.humidity.temperature) # temp and humidity both have significant effects on frog detection rates
summary(frog.survtype.humidity.temperature)

simulateResiduals(fittedModel = frog.survtype.humidity.temperature, plot = T) # passes
testZeroInflation(frog.survtype.humidity.temperature) # passes
testDispersion(frog.survtype.humidity.temperature) # passes

```

# Lizards

## Lizard models

```{r liz det rate model comparison, warning = FALSE}

liz_tallied <- liz_tallied %>%
  na.omit()

# null
liz.null <- glmmTMB(n ~ 1 + offset(log(survey_length_m)), data = liz_tallied, family = nbinom1())
summary(liz.null)
# AIC 254.8

# survey type
liz.survtype <- glmmTMB(n ~ Survey_Type + offset(log(survey_length_m)), data = liz_tallied, family = nbinom1())

summary(liz.survtype)
# 264.6 worse

# hunting
liz.hunt <- glmmTMB(n ~ Station + offset(log(survey_length_m)), data = liz_tallied, family = nbinom1())

summary(liz.hunt)
# better - keep in subsequent models
# 255.9

# year
liz.hunt.year <- glmmTMB(n ~ Station + Year+ offset(log(survey_length_m)), data = liz_tallied, family = nbinom1())

summary(liz.hunt.year)
# 255.0 bit better

# the plot indicates a year X hunting status interaction
liz.huntXyear <- glmmTMB(n ~ Station*Year + offset(log(survey_length_m)), data = liz_tallied, family = nbinom1())

summary(liz.huntXyear)
# AIC bit better 254.8 

# humidity
liz.huntXyear.humidity <- glmmTMB(n ~ Station*Year + humidity_scaled +  offset(log(survey_length_m)), data = liz_tallied, family = nbinom1())

summary(liz.huntXyear.humidity) # worse

# temperature
liz.huntXyear.temperature <- glmmTMB(n ~ Station*Year + temp_scaled +  offset(log(survey_length_m)), data = liz_tallied, family = nbinom1())

summary(liz.huntXyear.temperature)
# better

liz_mod_names <- c("liz.null", "liz.survtype", "liz.hunt", "liz.hunt.year", "liz.huntXyear", "liz.huntXyear.humidity", "liz.huntXyear.temperature")

# compare
aictab(cand.set = list(liz.null, liz.survtype, liz.hunt, liz.hunt.year, liz.huntXyear, liz.huntXyear.humidity, liz.huntXyear.temperature), modnames = liz_mod_names)

# best fit model results:

summary(liz.huntXyear.temperature)

simulateResiduals(fittedModel = liz.huntXyear.temperature, plot = T) 
testZeroInflation(liz.huntXyear.temperature) # passes
testDispersion(liz.huntXyear.temperature) # passes

```

```{r models snakes pooled}
all_snakes_tallied$Year <- factor(format(all_snakes_tallied$Start_Date, "%Y"))

  na.omit

summary(all.snakes.yr)
# AIC 208.8

# Year
all.snakes.yr <- glmmTMB(n_snakes ~ Year + offset(log(survey_length_m)), data = all_snakes_tallied.NA.omit, family = nbinom2)

summary(all.snakes.yr)                        
#AIC 208.8

# Hunting status (station)
all.snakes.hunt <-glmmTMB(n_snakes ~ Station + offset(log(survey_length_m)), data = all_snakes_tallied.NA.omit, family = nbinom2)

summary(all.snakes.hunt)
# AIC 210.7 worse

# humidity
all.snakes.humidity <-glmmTMB(n_snakes ~ humidity_scaled + offset(log(survey_length_m)), data = all_snakes_tallied.NA.omit, family = nbinom2)

summary(all.snakes.humidity)

# temp
all.snakes.temp <-glmmTMB(n_snakes ~ temp_scaled + offset(log(survey_length_m)), data = all_snakes_tallied.NA.omit, family = nbinom2)

summary(all.snakes.temp)
```

## Models 2 diet type w/survey-level aggregation

```{r models surv level two diet types}

two_guilds_tallied <- two_guilds_tallied %>%
  na.omit()

# null
snake.null <- glmmTMB(n_snakes ~ 1 + offset(log(survey_length_m)), data = two_guilds_tallied, family = nbinom2())

summary(snake.null)

# year
snake.yr <- glmmTMB(n_snakes ~ Year + offset(log(survey_length_m)), data = two_guilds_tallied, family = nbinom2())

summary(snake.yr)
# not better

# hunting
snake.hunt <- glmmTMB(n_snakes ~ Station + offset(log(survey_length_m)), data = two_guilds_tallied, family = nbinom2())

summary(snake.hunt)

# the plot indicates a hunting x guild
snake.huntXguild <- glmmTMB(n_snakes ~ Station/Diet_Type + offset(log(survey_length_m)), data = two_guilds_tallied, family = nbinom2())

summary(snake.huntXguild)

# humidity
snake.huntXguild.humidity <- glmmTMB(n_snakes ~ Station/Diet_Type + humidity_scaled + offset(log(survey_length_m)), data = two_guilds_tallied, family = nbinom2())

# temperature
snake.huntXguild.temp <- glmmTMB(n_snakes ~ Station/Diet_Type + temp_scaled + offset(log(survey_length_m)), data = two_guilds_tallied, family = nbinom2())
summary(snake.huntXguild.temp)

snake_mod_names <- c("snake.null", "snake.yr", "snake.hunt", "snake.huntXguild", "snake.huntXguild.humidity", "snake.huntXguild.temp")

# compare
aictab(cand.set = list(snake.null, snake.yr, snake.hunt, snake.huntXguild, snake.huntXguild.humidity, snake.huntXguild.temp), modnames = snake_mod_names)

# best fit model results:

simulateResiduals(fittedModel = snake.huntXguild, plot = T) 
testZeroInflation(snake.huntXguild) # passes
testDispersion(snake.huntXguild) # passes
```

## Models 2 diet type w/segment-level aggregation

```{r models segment level two diet types}

two_guilds_tallied_per_segment <- two_guilds_tallied_per_segment %>%
  na.omit()

# null
snake.seg.null <- glmmTMB(n_snakes ~ 1 + offset(log(Seg_dist_m)) + (1|Segment), data = two_guilds_tallied_per_segment, family = nbinom2())

summary(snake.seg.null)
# AIC 557.4

# year
snake.seg.yr <- glmmTMB(n_snakes ~ Year + offset(log(Seg_dist_m)) + (1|Segment), data = two_guilds_tallied_per_segment, family = nbinom2())

summary(snake.seg.yr)
# AIC 558.0 worse

summary(snake.seg.hunt)
# AIC worse 559.4

# the plot indicates a hunting x guild interaction
snake.seg.huntXguild <- glmmTMB(n_snakes ~ Station/Diet_Type + (1|Segment) + offset(log(Seg_dist_m)), data = two_guilds_tallied_per_segment, family = nbinom2())

# AIC 536.5 much better

# humidity
snake.seg.huntXguild.humidity <- glmmTMB(n_snakes ~ Station/Diet_Type + humidity_scaled + (1|Segment) + offset(log(Seg_dist_m)), data = two_guilds_tallied_per_segment, family = nbinom2())

summary(snake.seg.huntXguild.humidity)
# AIC 537.1 not better

# temperature
snake.seg.huntXguild.temperature <- glmmTMB(n_snakes ~ Station/Diet_Type + temp_scaled + (1|Segment) + offset(log(Seg_dist_m)), data = two_guilds_tallied_per_segment, family = nbinom2())

summary(snake.seg.huntXguild.temperature)
# AIC 537.8 not better

snake_mod_names <- c("snake.seg.null", "snake.seg.yr", "snake.seg.hunt", "snake.seg.huntXguild", "snake.seg.huntXguild.humidity", "snake.seg.huntXguild.temp")

aictab(cand.set = list(snake.seg.null, snake.seg.yr, snake.seg.hunt, snake.seg.huntXguild, snake.seg.huntXguild.humidity, snake.seg.huntXguild.temperature), modnames = snake_mod_names)

# best fit model results:

summary(snake.seg.huntXguild)

simulateResiduals(fittedModel = snake.seg.huntXguild, plot = T) 
testZeroInflation(snake.seg.huntXguild) # passes
testDispersion(snake.seg.huntXguild) # passes

Anova(snake.seg.huntXguild)

####
# detection rate continuous w/tweedie
# null
snake.seg.null <- glmmTMB(n_500m ~ 1 + (1|Segment), data = two_guilds_tallied_per_segment, family = tweedie())

summary(snake.seg.null)
# AIC 723.3

# year
```

# Density estimates

```{r gof function}

# using this resource: https://www.montana.edu/screel/teaching/bioe-440r-521/bioe-440-distance-sampling.html

# Goodness of fit test: good fit if results of these tests show p > 0.05. First, fit a model: use your best-supported model (Lowest AIC). Then check GOF for that model.

# Function returning three fit-statistics.

fitstats <- function(fm) {

  observed <- getY(fm@data)

  expected <- fitted(fm)

  resids <- residuals(fm)

  sse <- sum(resids^2)

  chisq <- sum((observed - expected)^2 / expected)

  freeTuke <- sum((sqrt(observed) - sqrt(expected))^2)

  out <- c(SSE=sse, Chisq=chisq, freemanTukey=freeTuke)

  return(out)

}

```

```{r using AI help}
# Import data
snake_data <- read.csv("snake_survey_data_columns_reduced.csv")

# Define distance breaks
dist_breaks <- c(0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0, 8.0, 12.0)

# Make transect and occasion columns factors
snake_data <- snake_data %>%
  mutate(
    Segment = factor(Segment),
    Occasion = factor(Start_Date)
  )

# Create site-level covariates (one row per transect)
site_covs <- snake_data %>%
  distinct(Segment, Station, Seg_dist_m) %>%
  arrange(Segment) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Set transect names as row names
rownames(site_covs) <- as.character(site_covs$Segment)

# Remove Segment from the covariate dataframe
site_covs <- site_covs %>%
  select(-Segment) %>%
  mutate(Station = factor(Station))

# Keep only observations with recorded detection distances
dist_data <- snake_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Distance_From_Trail_m)) %>%
  mutate(
    Segment = factor(Segment, levels = levels(snake_data$Segment)),
    Occasion = factor(Occasion, levels = levels(snake_data$Occasion))
  )

# Create an effort matrix to identify which transects
# were surveyed during each occasion
transects <- levels(snake_data$Segment)
occasions <- levels(snake_data$Occasion)

effort_matrix <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = length(transects),
  ncol = length(occasions),
  dimnames = list(transects, occasions)
)

surveyed <- snake_data %>%
  distinct(Segment, Occasion)

effort_matrix[
  cbind(
    match(surveyed$Segment, transects),
    match(surveyed$Occasion, occasions)
  )
] <- 1

# Format distance data
y_dist <- formatDistData(
  distData = dist_data,
  distCol = "Distance_From_Trail_m",
  transectNameCol = "Segment",
  occasionCol = "Occasion",
  dist.breaks = dist_breaks,
  effortMatrix = effort_matrix
)

# Ensure covariates follow the same transect order as y_dist
site_covs <- site_covs[rownames(y_dist), , drop = FALSE]

# Create unmarked data frame for repeated distance sampling
snake_umf <- unmarkedFrameGDS(
  y = as.matrix(y_dist),
  siteCovs = site_covs,
  numPrimary = length(occasions),
  dist.breaks = dist_breaks,
  tlength = site_covs$Seg_dist_m,
  survey = "line",
  unitsIn = "m"
)

# Examine the resulting data
summary(snake_umf)

snake_model <- gdistsamp(
  lambdaformula = ~ Station,
  phiformula = ~ 1,
  pformula = ~ 1,
  data = snake_umf,
  K = 100,
  output = "density"
)

summary(snake_model)
```

```{r estimates per diet type}
library(dplyr)
library(unmarked)

# Import data
snake_data <- read.csv("snake_survey_data_columns_reduced.csv")

# Define distance bins
dist_breaks <- c(0, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8, 12)

# Set factors
snake_data <- snake_data %>%
  mutate(
    Segment = factor(Segment),
    Occasion = factor(Start_Date,
                      levels = sort(unique(Start_Date))),
    Station = factor(Station,
                     levels = c("TBS", "YRS"))
  )

transects <- levels(snake_data$Segment)
occasions <- levels(snake_data$Occasion)

# Site-level information
site_info <- snake_data %>%
  distinct(Segment, Station, Seg_dist_m) %>%
  mutate(Segment = as.character(Segment))

# Construct effort matrix using ALL surveys
effort_matrix <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = length(transects),
  ncol = length(occasions),
  dimnames = list(transects, occasions)
)

surveyed <- snake_data %>%
  distinct(Segment, Occasion)

effort_matrix[
  cbind(
    match(as.character(surveyed$Segment), transects),
    match(as.character(surveyed$Occasion), occasions)
  )
] <- 1


# Function to create a distance sampling data object
make_gds <- function(diet_group) {

  # Select detections belonging to this diet group
  detections <- snake_data %>%
    filter(
      Diet_Type == diet_group,
      !is.na(Distance_From_Trail_m)
    )

  # Format distance data
  y <- formatDistData(
    distData = detections,
    distCol = "Distance_From_Trail_m",
    transectNameCol = "Segment",
    occasionCol = "Occasion",
    dist.breaks = dist_breaks,
    effortMatrix = effort_matrix
  )

  # Match site covariates to response matrix
  si <- site_info[
    match(rownames(y), site_info$Segment),
  ]

  # Site covariates
  site_covs <- data.frame(
    Station = factor(
      si$Station,
      levels = levels(snake_data$Station)
    )
  )

  rownames(site_covs) <- rownames(y)

  # Create unmarkedFrameGDS
  umf <- unmarkedFrameGDS(
    y = as.matrix(y),
    siteCovs = site_covs,
    numPrimary = length(occasions),
    dist.breaks = dist_breaks,
    tlength = si$Seg_dist_m,
    survey = "line",
    unitsIn = "m"
  )

  return(umf)
}


# Create separate data objects
umf_no_mammals <- make_gds("no_mammals")

umf_consumes_mammals <- make_gds("consumes_mammals")
```

```{r gdist models}

#Fit an intercept-only model
null <- gdistsamp(
  lambdaformula = ~1, # Abundance covariates
  phiformula = ~1,    # Availability covariates 
  pformula = ~1,      # Detection covariates
  data = umf, 
  mixture = "P"       # Mixture distribution: "P" (Poisson) or "NB" (Negative Binomial)
)

# View results
summary(null)

# include station
station <- gdistsamp(
  lambdaformula = ~Station, # Abundance covariates
  phiformula = ~1,    # Availability covariates

)
```

```{r chat gpt 2}
  )

# Identify all transects, including those with zero detections
transects <- levels(snake_data$Segment)

# Calculate total survey effort for each transect
# Each unique survey date counts as one survey
site_info <- snake_data %>%
  distinct(Segment, Start_Date, Station, Seg_dist_m) %>%
  group_by(Segment) %>%
  summarise(
    Station = first(Station),
    Seg_dist_m = first(Seg_dist_m),
    n_surveys = n(),
    total_effort_m = Seg_dist_m * n_surveys,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Segment = as.character(Segment))

# Function to create a distance sampling data object
make_ds <- function(diet_group) {

  # Select detections belonging to the specified diet group
  detections <- snake_data %>%
    filter(
      Diet_Type == diet_group,
      !is.na(Distance_From_Trail_m),
      Distance_From_Trail_m >= 0,
      Distance_From_Trail_m <= 12
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Segment = factor(
        as.character(Segment),
        levels = transects
      )
    )

  # Format distance data (no occasion column)
  y <- formatDistData(
    distData = detections,
    distCol = "Distance_From_Trail_m",
    transectNameCol = "Segment",
    dist.breaks = dist_breaks
  )

  # Match site covariates to response matrix
  si <- site_info[
    match(rownames(y), site_info$Segment),
  ]

  site_covs <- data.frame(
    Station = factor(
      si$Station,
      levels = c("TBS", "YRS")
    )
  )

  rownames(site_covs) <- rownames(y)

  # Create unmarkedFrameDS
  umf <- unmarkedFrameDS(
    y = as.matrix(y),
    siteCovs = site_covs,
    dist.breaks = dist_breaks,
    tlength = si$total_effort_m,
    survey = "line",
    unitsIn = "m"
  )

  return(umf)
}


# Create separate data objects for each diet group
umf_no_mammals <- make_ds("no_mammals")

umf_consumes_mammals <- make_ds("consumes_mammals")

# ---------------------------------
# NO-MAMMAL SNAKES
# ---------------------------------

# Null model
model.no.null <- distsamp(
  ~ 1 ~ 1,
  data = umf_no_mammals,
  keyfun = "halfnorm",
  output = "density",
  unitsOut = "ha"
)

# Station effect on density
model.no.station <- distsamp(
  ~ 1 ~ Station,
  data = umf_no_mammals,
  keyfun = "halfnorm",
  output = "density",
  unitsOut = "ha"
)


# ---------------------------------
# MAMMAL-CONSUMING SNAKES
# ---------------------------------

# Null model
model.mammal.null <- distsamp(
  ~ 1 ~ 1,
  data = umf_consumes_mammals,
  output = "density",
  unitsOut = "km"
)

# Station effect on density
model.mammal.station <- distsamp(
  ~ 1 ~ Station,
  data = umf_consumes_mammals,
  output = "density",
  unitsOut = "km"
)



# Examine model estimates
summary(model.no.station)

summary(model.mammal.null)
summary(model.mammal.station)

# Examine data objects
summary(umf_no_mammals)

summary(umf_consumes_mammals)

# Create prediction dataframe
station_predictions <- data.frame(
  Station = factor(
    c("TBS", "YRS"),
    levels = c("TBS", "YRS")
  )
)

# Predict density of snakes that do not consume mammals
pred.no.mammals <- predict(
  model.no.station,
  type = "state",
  newdata = station_predictions
)

# Predict density of mammal-consuming snakes
pred.mammals <- predict(
  model.mammal.station,
  type = "state",
  newdata = station_predictions
)

# View predictions
pred.no.mammals
pred.mammals
```

```{r chat gpt cont}
library(dplyr)
library(unmarked)

# Import data
snake_data <- read.csv("snake_survey_data_columns_reduced.csv")

# Distance bins
dist_breaks <- c(0, 0.5, 1, 2, 5)

# Prepare data
snake_data <- snake_data %>%
  mutate(
    Segment = as.character(Segment),
    Station = factor(Station, levels = c("TBS", "YRS"))
  )

# Create site-level dataset
site_info <- snake_data %>%
  group_by(Segment) %>%
  summarise(
    Station = first(Station),
    Seg_dist_m = first(Seg_dist_m),
    n_surveys = n_distinct(Start_Date),
    total_effort_m = Seg_dist_m * n_surveys,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Function to create an unmarkedFrameDS
make_ds <- function(diet_group, selected_sites) {

  detections <- snake_data %>%
    filter(
      Diet_Type == diet_group,
      !is.na(Distance_From_Trail_m),
      Distance_From_Trail_m >= 0,
      Distance_From_Trail_m <= 5
    ) %>%
    inner_join(
      selected_sites,
      by = c("Segment" = "source_segment")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Segment = factor(
        boot_segment,
        levels = selected_sites$boot_segment
      )
    )

  # Format distance data
  y <- formatDistData(
    distData = detections,
    distCol = "Distance_From_Trail_m",
    transectNameCol = "Segment",
    dist.breaks = dist_breaks
  )

  # Match site covariates
  si <- selected_sites[
    match(rownames(y), selected_sites$boot_segment),
  ]

  site_covs <- data.frame(
    Station = factor(
      si$Station,
      levels = c("TBS", "YRS")
    )
  )

  rownames(site_covs) <- rownames(y)

  # Create distance sampling object
  unmarkedFrameDS(
    y = as.matrix(y),
    siteCovs = site_covs,
    dist.breaks = dist_breaks,
    tlength = si$total_effort_m,
    survey = "line",
    unitsIn = "m"
  )
}


# Create original site dataset
original_sites <- site_info %>%
  mutate(
    source_segment = Segment,
    boot_segment = Segment
  )

# Create original data objects
umf_no_mammals <- make_ds(
  "no_mammals",
  original_sites
)

umf_consumes_mammals <- make_ds(
  "consumes_mammals",
  original_sites
)


# Fit original models
model_no_mammals <- distsamp(
  ~ 1 ~ Station,
  data = umf_no_mammals,
  keyfun = "halfnorm",
  output = "density",
  unitsOut = "km"
)

model_consumes_mammals <- distsamp(
  ~ 1 ~ Station,
  data = umf_consumes_mammals,
  keyfun = "halfnorm",
  output = "density",
  unitsOut = "km"
)

summary(model_no_mammals)
summary(model_consumes_mammals)

# 3
get_station_contrast <- function(model) {

  predictions <- predict(
    model,
    type = "state",
    newdata = data.frame(
      Station = factor(
        c("TBS", "YRS"),
        levels = c("TBS", "YRS")
      )
    )
  )

  density_TBS <- predictions$Predicted[1]
  density_YRS <- predictions$Predicted[2]

  log_RR <- log(density_YRS / density_TBS)

  return(c(
    Density_TBS = density_TBS,
    Density_YRS = density_YRS,
    Log_RR = log_RR
  ))
}


# Original station contrasts
contrast_no_mammals <- get_station_contrast(
  model_no_mammals
)

contrast_consumes_mammals <- get_station_contrast(
  model_consumes_mammals
)

contrast_no_mammals
contrast_consumes_mammals


# Calculate difference between station contrasts
observed_interaction <-
  contrast_consumes_mammals["Log_RR"] -
  contrast_no_mammals["Log_RR"]

observed_interaction

# 4
set.seed(123)

# Number of bootstrap iterations
n_boot <- 10


# Function to fit both models and extract contrasts
run_bootstrap <- function(selected_sites) {

  tryCatch({

    # Create data objects
    umf_no <- make_ds(
      "no_mammals",
      selected_sites
    )

    umf_mammal <- make_ds(
      "consumes_mammals",
      selected_sites
    )

    # Fit models
    fit_no <- distsamp(
      ~ 1 ~ Station,
      data = umf_no,
      keyfun = "halfnorm",
      output = "density",
      unitsOut = "km"
    )

    fit_mammal <- distsamp(
      ~ 1 ~ Station,
      data = umf_mammal,
      keyfun = "halfnorm",
      output = "density",
      unitsOut = "km"
    )

    # Extract density contrasts
    con_no <- get_station_contrast(fit_no)

    con_mammal <- get_station_contrast(fit_mammal)

    # Calculate interaction
    interaction <-
      con_mammal["Log_RR"] -
      con_no["Log_RR"]

    c(
      RR_no_mammals = exp(con_no["Log_RR"]),
      RR_consumes_mammals = exp(con_mammal["Log_RR"]),
      Interaction = interaction
    )

  }, error = function(e) {

    c(
      RR_no_mammals = NA,
      RR_consumes_mammals = NA,
      Interaction = NA
    )

  })
}


# Bootstrap loop
bootstrap_results <- vector("list", n_boot)

TBS_sites <- site_info %>%
  filter(Station == "TBS")

YRS_sites <- site_info %>%
  filter(Station == "YRS")

n = nrow(TBS_sites)  # 42 transects
n = nrow(YRS_sites)  # 47 transects

for (i in seq_len(n_boot)) {

  # Resample transects within each station
  sampled_TBS <- site_info %>%
    filter(Station == "TBS") %>%
    slice_sample(n = nrow(TBS_sites), replace = TRUE)

  sampled_YRS <- site_info %>%
    filter(Station == "YRS") %>%
    slice_sample(n = nrow(YRS_sites), replace = TRUE)

  sampled_sites <- bind_rows(
    sampled_TBS,
    sampled_YRS
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      source_segment = Segment,
      boot_segment = paste0(
        as.character(Station),
        "_bootstrap_",
        row_number()
      )
    )

  # Fit models and extract estimates
  bootstrap_results[[i]] <- run_bootstrap(
    sampled_sites
  )
}


# Combine bootstrap results
bootstrap_results <- as.data.frame(
  do.call(rbind, bootstrap_results)
)

# Remove failed model fits
bootstrap_results <- bootstrap_results %>%
  filter(
    complete.cases(.),
    if_all(everything(), is.finite)
  )

# Check successful bootstrap iterations
nrow(bootstrap_results)

# 5
# Calculate observed density ratios
observed_no <- as.numeric(
  contrast_no_mammals["Log_RR"]
)

observed_mammal <- as.numeric(
  contrast_consumes_mammals["Log_RR"]
)

observed_int <- as.numeric(
  observed_interaction
)


# Bootstrap distributions on log scale
boot_no <- log(bootstrap_results$RR_no_mammals)

boot_mammal <- log(
  bootstrap_results$RR_consumes_mammals
)

boot_int <- bootstrap_results$Interaction


# Function to calculate bootstrap statistics
bootstrap_summary <- function(boot, observed) {

  boot <- boot[is.finite(boot)]

  # Percentile confidence interval
  CI <- quantile(
    boot,
    probs = c(0.025, 0.975),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  # Two-sided centered bootstrap test
  centered_errors <- boot - observed

  p_value <- (
    1 + sum(
      abs(centered_errors) >= abs(observed)
    )
  ) / (length(boot) + 1)

  c(
    Estimate = exp(observed),
    Lower_95_CI = exp(CI[1]),
    Upper_95_CI = exp(CI[2]),
    P_value = p_value
  )
}


# Summarize all three comparisons
results <- rbind(

  No_mammal_snakes = bootstrap_summary(
    boot_no,
    observed_no
  ),

  Mammal_consuming_snakes = bootstrap_summary(
    boot_mammal,
    observed_mammal
  ),

  Diet_by_Station_interaction = bootstrap_summary(
    boot_int,
    observed_int
  )

)

round(results, 4)

# 6
library(ggplot2)

results_plot <- data.frame(
  Comparison = rownames(results),
  Estimate = results[, "Estimate"],
  Lower = results[, "Lower_95_CI.2.5%"],
  Upper = results[, "Upper_95_CI.97.5%"]
)

ggplot(

) +

  ) +

  scale_x_log10() +

    x = "Density ratio (YRS / TBS)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```
